notes: Small manually inspected demo frame set; not held-out precision/recall evaluation.
Phone model unchanged, confidence 0.45; person crops improve a visually correct office phone box from 0.329 to 0.636.
RF-DETR CigDet full-frame confidence 0.85 selected conservatively after inspecting real and false candidates. Per-person RF-DETR crops increased false candidates and are disabled for this model.
Person confidence 0.35 excludes a spurious 0.251 head box in a four-person scene; it does not guarantee perfect person counts.
limits: Training overlap of stock examples is unknown.
Partial occlusions, tiny objects and ambiguous hand-held objects can still cause missed or false boxes.
Object presence is separated from action review and operator verdict.
